cards.title: Introduction to Error Handling
cards.content: Error handling in ASP.NET Core is essential for robust applications. It ensures that unhandled exceptions are caught, logged, and translated into meaningful responses for the client without exposing sensitive server details.

content.question: Which middleware should typically be used only in the Development environment to show detailed exception information?

cards.title: Configuring Exception Handler
cards.content:
In production, you should use the exception handler middleware to catch exceptions and redirect the request to a friendly error pipeline or controller.

if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseExceptionHandler("/Home/Error");
    app.UseHsts();
}

content.text: To enable status code pages that return content for status codes like 404 without bodies, you call app.Use_______Pages(); in Program.cs.

pairs.right: Detailed stack traces for local debugging
Catches exceptions and redirects to error endpoint
Handles empty response status codes like 404

cards.title: Problem Details (RFC 7807)
cards.content:
ASP.NET Core has built-in support for generating standardized error responses using the ProblemDetails class, which is especially useful for REST APIs.

return Results.Problem("Server error occurred.", statusCode: 500);

options.text: It leads to repetitive boilerplate code and inconsistent error responses.

cards.title: Exception Filters and IExceptionHandler
cards.content:
Starting with .NET 8, ASP.NET Core introduced the IExceptionHandler interface for a centralized, elegant way to handle exceptions globally.

public class GlobalExceptionHandler : IExceptionHandler
{
    public async ValueTask<bool> TryHandleAsync(HttpContext context, 
        Exception exception, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Log and handle exception
        return true;
    }
}

cards.title: Error Handling Summary
cards.content: You have covered the core concepts of error handling in ASP.NET Core: Developer Exception Pages, Production Exception Handlers, Status Code Pages, Problem Details for APIs, and modern global exception handlers.
